I am a graduate AI/software engineer focused on **RAG applications**, **computer vision**, and **systems-level software**.
I recently completed a Master of Artificial Intelligence at RMIT and have built applied AI projects using **Python**, **PyTorch**, **LangChain**, **ChromaDB**, and local LLMs. I also contributed review-ready C patches to FreeBSD/QEMU through Google Summer of Code.
